hints.title: Check Two Conditions
hints.text: For number x, check if either 2 * x exists in seen values, or x is even and x // 2 exists in seen values.

hints.title: One Pass Lookup
hints.text: Add elements to a collection one by one. Check existing elements before inserting the current one.

hints.title: Early Return True
hints.text: If match condition is met at any point, immediately return true. Otherwise return false after checking all elements.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops take quadratic time O(N^2) and must carefully avoid i == j.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set lookup verifies 2x and x/2 presence in constant time per element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the zero edge case (0 * 2 = 0) properly by checking i != j.
complexity.notes: Checking seen before inserting automatically avoids self-pairing for 0.
